title: Phoenix Quick Reference
description: Look up a lesson idea, see its small example, and check a common mistake. Open the linked lesson for setup and practice steps.

entries.name: Make a controller reply
entries.summary: The router maps GET /hello to a controller action. text sends a plain response.

example.code:
# lib/school_web/router.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.Router do
 use SchoolWeb, :router
 pipeline :api do
  plug :accepts, ["json"]
 end
 scope "/", SchoolWeb do
  pipe_through :api
get "/hello", LessonController, :hello
 end
end

# lib/school_web/controllers/lesson_controller.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.LessonController do
 use SchoolWeb, :controller
def hello(conn, _params), do: text(conn, "Hello, Asha!")
end

notes: The SchoolWeb module prefix must match the app name school.

entries.name: Send JSON data
entries.summary: json turns an Elixir map into a JSON reply. Open GET /book.

example.code:
# lib/school_web/router.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.Router do
 use SchoolWeb, :router
 pipeline :api do
  plug :accepts, ["json"]
 end
 scope "/", SchoolWeb do
  pipe_through :api
get "/book", LessonController, :book
 end
end

# lib/school_web/controllers/lesson_controller.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.LessonController do
 use SchoolWeb, :controller
def book(conn, _params), do: json(conn, %{title: "Moon Trip"})
end

notes: A map holds named data; its field order is not important.

entries.name: Read a path value
entries.summary: A colon marks a router input. Pattern matching reads its string-keyed parameter. Open GET /hello/Ravi.

example.code:
# lib/school_web/router.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.Router do
 use SchoolWeb, :router
 pipeline :api do
  plug :accepts, ["json"]
 end
 scope "/", SchoolWeb do
  pipe_through :api
get "/hello/:name", LessonController, :hello
 end
end

# lib/school_web/controllers/lesson_controller.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.LessonController do
 use SchoolWeb, :controller
def hello(conn, %{"name" => name}), do: text(conn, "Hi, #{name}!")
end

notes: HTTP parameter keys are strings, not atoms.

entries.name: Read query data
entries.summary: The params map includes query values. Open GET /search?q=cat.

example.code:

# lib/school_web/controllers/lesson_controller.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.LessonController do

end

entries.name: Check a path number
entries.summary: Integer.parse reads a number and the unused text. Open GET /double/4.

example.code:
# lib/school_web/router.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.Router do
 use SchoolWeb, :router
 pipeline :api do
  plug :accepts, ["json"]
 end
 scope "/", SchoolWeb do
  pipe_through :api
get "/double/:n", LessonController, :twice
 end
end

# lib/school_web/controllers/lesson_controller.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.LessonController do
 use SchoolWeb, :controller
def twice(conn, %{"n" => raw}) do
 case Integer.parse(raw) do
  {n, ""} -> json(conn, %{answer: n * 2})
  _ -> conn |> put_status(400) |> json(%{error: "Use a whole number"})
 end
end
end

notes: Check that no trailing text remains after the parsed number.

entries.name: Read JSON parameters
entries.summary: Send POST /books with application/json and {"title":"Moon Trip"}. The endpoint parser puts the fields into params.

example.code:
# lib/school_web/router.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.Router do
 use SchoolWeb, :router
 pipeline :api do
  plug :accepts, ["json"]
 end
 scope "/", SchoolWeb do
  pipe_through :api
post "/books", LessonController, :create
 end
end

# lib/school_web/controllers/lesson_controller.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.LessonController do
 use SchoolWeb, :controller
def create(conn, %{"title" => title}) when is_binary(title), do: conn |> put_status(201) |> json(%{title: title})
def create(conn, _params), do: conn |> put_status(400) |> json(%{error: "Title needed"})
end

notes: Provide a fallback function clause for input that does not match.

entries.name: Report a missing item
entries.summary: put_status returns an updated connection. Pass that value to json. Open GET /missing.

example.code:
# lib/school_web/router.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.Router do
 use SchoolWeb, :router
 pipeline :api do
  plug :accepts, ["json"]
 end
 scope "/", SchoolWeb do
  pipe_through :api
get "/missing", LessonController, :missing
 end
end

# lib/school_web/controllers/lesson_controller.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.LessonController do
 use SchoolWeb, :controller
def missing(conn, _params), do: conn |> put_status(404) |> json(%{error: "Book not found"})
end

notes: Connection functions return a new value; keep using that returned value.

entries.name: Set response metadata
entries.summary: put_resp_header adds a header to the connection. Open GET /note.

example.code:
# lib/school_web/router.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.Router do
 use SchoolWeb, :router
 pipeline :api do
  plug :accepts, ["json"]
 end
 scope "/", SchoolWeb do
  pipe_through :api
get "/note", LessonController, :note
 end
end

# lib/school_web/controllers/lesson_controller.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.LessonController do
 use SchoolWeb, :controller
def note(conn, _params), do: conn |> put_resp_header("cache-control", "no-store") |> text("Practice note")
end

notes: Use lower-case header names with Plug.

entries.name: Return a redirect
entries.summary: redirect sends a location. A browser following GET /start reaches /hello.

example.code:
# lib/school_web/router.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.Router do
 use SchoolWeb, :router
 pipeline :api do
  plug :accepts, ["json"]
 end
 scope "/", SchoolWeb do
  pipe_through :api
get "/start", LessonController, :start
get "/hello", LessonController, :hello
 end
end

# lib/school_web/controllers/lesson_controller.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.LessonController do
 use SchoolWeb, :controller
def start(conn, _params), do: redirect(conn, to: "/hello")
def hello(conn, _params), do: text(conn, "Welcome")
end

notes: Use an internal path for this example, not an unchecked outside destination.

entries.name: Stop later processing
entries.summary: halt marks the connection so later plugs stop. Open GET /closed.

example.code:
# lib/school_web/router.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.Router do
 use SchoolWeb, :router
 pipeline :api do
  plug :accepts, ["json"]
 end
 scope "/", SchoolWeb do
  pipe_through :api
get "/closed", LessonController, :closed
 end
end

# lib/school_web/controllers/lesson_controller.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.LessonController do
 use SchoolWeb, :controller
def closed(conn, _params), do: conn |> send_resp(403, "Closed for practice") |> halt()
end

notes: halt does not itself send a response; send it first.

entries.name: Return no content
entries.summary: send_resp can send an empty body with status 204. Send DELETE /books/1.

example.code:
# lib/school_web/router.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.Router do
 use SchoolWeb, :router
 pipeline :api do
  plug :accepts, ["json"]
 end
 scope "/", SchoolWeb do
  pipe_through :api
delete "/books/:id", LessonController, :remove
 end
end

# lib/school_web/controllers/lesson_controller.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.LessonController do
 use SchoolWeb, :controller
def remove(conn, _params), do: send_resp(conn, 204, "")
end

notes: This practice action has no database record to remove.
